I can't give you the exact `just` recipe name, because this checkout doesn't have the justfile yet. `main` (at `d145983`) still has the old `Makefile` and no justfile, so the switch to `just` probably hasn't been merged into this branch.

The fast tests are the run that skips the Postgres tests. The old `test-fast` target ran this:

```sh
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

That command works no matter which task runner you use. `just test` probably runs everything, and the old full run needed the database started first with `docker compose up db`. If your justfile has a fast recipe, `just --list` will show its name. It's likely called `test-fast`, so you'd run `just test-fast`.

The project's memory store still said "run `make test-fast`". I've flagged that note as possibly out of date and added what you told me. Once the justfile is merged here, it should be updated with the correct `just` command.
